question: Indian Army’s 1st women combat aviator is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhilasha Barak.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Captain Abhilasha Barak has created history by becoming the first woman officer to join the Army Aviation Corps as Combat Aviator. 
 
• Captain Barak's achievement has been described as a "Golden Letter Day" in the history of Indian Army Aviation. 
 
• She was awarded the coveted wings along with** 36 other army pilots** during a ceremony held at the Combat Army Aviation Training School in Nashik.
 
• Abhilasha Barak hails from **Haryana**, India.

 [IMAGE: https://wikibio.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Abhilasha-Barak-undergoing-training-at-OTA.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• India's 1st woman Rafale fighter jet pilot Shivangi Singh was part of the Indian Air Force tableau at the Republic Day Parade 2022.
 
• She is only the 2nd woman fighter jet pilot to be part of the **IAF tableau.**
 
• In 2021, Flight Lieutenant Bhawna Kanth became the first female fighter jet pilot to be part of the IAF tableau. 
 
• The IAF tableau's theme- 'Indian Air Force transforming for the future'.
 
• Avani Chaturvedi is one of the three first three Indian female fighter pilots who received the 'Nari Shakti Puraskar 2019' on 8th March 2020.
 
• The President of India presented the prize to Avani Chaturvedi along with Mohana Jitarwa and Bhawna Kanth.
 
• The trio was inducted into the IAF's fighter squadron after the Government of India decided to open a fighter stream in the force for women on an experimental basis.
 
• The three were the first to be inducted into the squadron and conduct a solo flight in MIG-21 in 2018.
